rounds.text: Accedere Ltd carries valuation and historical return risks that are not fully supported by its recent growth spike. A discounted cash flow model places intrinsic value at Rs 67 per share against a market price of Rs 67.9, resulting in a negative margin of safety of -1.5% [E43, E44]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF indicates that the current share price already demands an 18.4% earnings growth rate, surpassing the 18.0% growth assumed in the base case [E45]. Historical profitability metrics also reveal long-term weakness, highlighted by a 10-year median return on equity of just 2% and a low 3-year median ROE of 9% [E25, E27]. The stock exhibits extreme volatility of 86.8% alongside a severe historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -96.0%, while offering a 0.00% dividend yield [E51, E52, E58]. Conceded: compounded sales growth has reached 50% over 10 and 5 years, and 12-month median ROE stands at a stronger 16% [E14, E15, E28].
